snapshot.name: Reliance Industries Ltd
snapshot.about: Reliance was founded by Dhirubhai Ambani and is now promoted and managed by his elder son, Mukesh Dhirubhai Ambani. Ambani's family has about 50% shareholding in the conglomerate.

latest_quarter.source: screener quarterly table (standardised from exchange filing)
latest_quarter.headline: Revenue +30% YoY, EBITDA +23%, PAT +34%, margin 17.1% (-0.9pp YoY)

notes.text: Growth is slowing: revenue CAGR 18% over 5y → 6% over 3y

business_mix.what_it_does: Reliance Industries Limited operates across multiple business segments including Oil-to-Chemicals (O2C), digital services through Jio Platforms, new energy, and retail commerce.

segments.name: Oil-to-Chemicals (O2C)
segments.note: Led the charge with EBITDA up 68% and benefited from tightness in energy markets.

segments.name: Jio Platforms (Digital Services)
segments.note: Includes mobility, fixed wireless, enterprise, and digital add-ons with a subscriber base of 542 million.

segments.name: New Energy
segments.note: Accelerating with earnings contribution expected starting in FY 2028.

segments.name: Retail / Consumer Business
segments.note: Includes grocery, apparel, footwear, and consumer electronics through omni-channel networks and physical stores.

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Investments in retail and new energy will drive future value, margins, and accretive bottom-line results.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Sales grew from 231535.0 INR crore in Sep 2024 to 330601.0 INR crore in Sep 2026, and Net Profit moved from 19323.0 to 29550.0 INR crore over the same period.

promises.credibility: Management guidance relies heavily on long-term horizons extending into FY 2028 and FY 2029, leaving most specific operational and capacity promises unverified by current quarterly financial statements.

bull: Revenue grew 30% YoY in the latest quarter ending Sep 2026, alongside a 34% increase in PAT.
The 5-year cumulative CFO is robust at 1.90x PAT, totaling ₹755,290 Cr against ₹398,016 Cr.
The 5-year free cash flow stands at ₹129,190 Cr, remaining positive in 4 out of 5 years.
bear: Long-term growth is slowing significantly, with the revenue CAGR dropping from 18% over 5 years to 6% over 3 years.
Working capital is stretching, as seen by the cash conversion cycle worsening from -3 to 25 days.
The latest quarter margin declined by 0.9pp YoY to settle at 17.1%.
untraced: The 5-year free cash flow stands at ₹129,190 Cr, remaining positive in 4 out of 5 years.
